purpose: Teach: 端子/ボルト/区画/キャップ/ポンプ/累積/買取/格納

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、端子製造を自ら指導されたぞ
lines.en: When you were young, you personally oversaw the connector manufacturing.
lines.style: Measured, proud. Slight pause after each phrase. Quiet warmth underneath — remembering. The voice of someone speaking what he's held for decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはボルトの強度にこだわられた
lines.en: Yes. Father was exacting about bolt integrity.
lines.style: Respectful, almost ceremonial. Each word given its weight. Speaking into the gravity of the memory, not away from it. Steady eye-contact tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、市場の区画化を進められたぞ
lines.en: You pioneered market segmentation in those days.
lines.style: Wistful, reaching back. Softer attack. The voice of someone who watched something grow. Slight catch of admiration in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品のキャップを丁寧に設計されました
lines.en: Yes. Father designed every product cap with real care.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Not lecturing — placing a memory down carefully, like it matters. Warm but composed. The tone of a son who understood what his father was teaching him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、初期のポンプ製造を見守られたぞ
lines.en: And you oversaw the early pump manufacturing line with such attention.
lines.style: Slower pace now. Each word deliberate. The voice of someone who watched his father watch something precious being built. Quiet awe underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは累積利益を毎年確認されました
lines.en: Yes. Father reviewed the cumulative margins every single year.
lines.style: Quieter now. Speaking from something deeper. Not proud in a loud way — proud in the way of someone who sees the pattern. Small, firm conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、買取り部門を立ち上げられたぞ
lines.en: You built the repurchasing division from nothing.
lines.style: Slow, reverent. The weight of the accomplishment sitting in the silence between words. Voice like hands placing something down with care. Final statement of a full picture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは在庫格納方法も整備されました
lines.en: Yes. Father perfected the inventory systems that made it all possible.
lines.style: Quiet closure. Slow, complete. The final piece settling into place. Voice of someone who has just finished telling the whole story — tired, satisfied, at peace with what was built.
